Maya (CS): Quick check for Shorehaven private deploy: network, IAM, KMS, audit logs?
Ravi (NetEng): Peering done. Need their FW team to add our health IP 10.66.77.88/32 to inbound.
Leah (Sec): IAM role they sent is too broad. Asked them to switch to a scoped role for the audit bucket and to attach kms:Decrypt only for the key alias/shorehaven-audit.
Tom (Observability): CloudTrail writes to S3 but our collector gets 403 on fetchs. Likely bucket policy denies our role or ExternalId mismatch.
shorehaven-ops: Adding firewall rule now, will confirm in ~10m. Also updating role trust policy per your snippet.
Maya (CS): Two risks: 1) firewall delay blocking smoke tests, 2) IAM/KMS not accepted by their sec lead. Eval credits expire in 9 days — if go-live slips >5 days we flag renewal risk to AM.
Leah (Sec): I'll send a minimal trust + S3 bucket policy example and KMS key policy sample.
Ravi (NetEng): I'll post net diagram and NAT egress IPs.
Tom (Observability): Once whitelist live I'll re-run ingest test and paste logs. Repro command: `aws s3 ls s3://shorehaven-audit/ --profile shorehaven` -> 403.
Maya (CS): Actions: Maya schedule 30m enablement with their Sec+Infra (Thu 10am PT); Leah prepare policies (Wed EOD); Ravi net diagram (Wed EOD); Tom SIEM checklist (Wed EOD); shorehaven to confirm whitelist + role acceptance. Post updates here.
